2. Due to its massive population (over 1.4 billion people), China has a very large absolute number of overweight and obese individuals, surpassing countries with much smaller total populations like Japan, even though its per-capita obesity rate is lower than some Western nations. 
3. When comparing the absolute number of obese individuals, China frequently ranks at or near the very top globally, easily surpassing countries like Japan. 

Therefore, among the given choices, China has more obesity than Japan.
